fills.en: Ms. Ortiz gave a very ___ presentation on the new lamp series.
fills.zh: Ortiz 女士針對新的檯燈系列做了一場很有內容的簡報。
fills.note: 形容詞修飾名詞 presentation，用 informative。

fills.en: The accounting team ___ the quarterly budget since early March.
fills.zh: 會計團隊從三月初就一直在審查這一季的預算。
fills.note: 有 since early March，動作從過去持續到現在，用現在完成進行式。

fills.en: ___ the sudden rise in material costs, the factory kept its prices the same.
fills.zh: 儘管材料成本突然上漲，工廠還是維持原本的價格。
fills.note: 後面是名詞片語，又是「儘管」的語意，用介系詞 despite；although 和 because 後面要接子句。

fills.en: All visitors must wear protective ___ on the factory floor.
fills.zh: 所有訪客在工廠廠區都必須穿戴防護裝備。
fills.note: protective gear 是「防護裝備」。

fills.en: Mr. Hughes asked Ms. Varga and ___ to read the contract before the meeting.
fills.zh: Hughes 先生請 Varga 女士和我在開會前讀過合約。
fills.note: 放在動詞 asked 後面當受詞，用受格 me。

fills.en: The signed contract must be returned to our office ___ Friday, March 7.
fills.zh: 簽好的合約必須在三月七日星期五之前寄回我們辦公室。
fills.note: 「在某個期限之前完成」用 by；until 用在持續的動作。

fills.en: Sales of the Lantern desk lamp have increased ___ over the past three quarters.
fills.zh: Lantern 檯燈的銷售在過去三季穩定成長。
fills.note: 修飾動詞 increased，要用副詞 steadily。

fills.en: Employees who travel for work can ask for ___ of their taxi and hotel costs.
fills.zh: 出差的員工可以申請計程車和住宿費用的報銷。
fills.note: reimbursement 是「報銷、退款」。

fills.en: The board meeting was moved to Thursday ___ the president was not available on Wednesday.
fills.zh: 董事會議改到星期四，因為總裁星期三沒空。
fills.note: 後面是完整子句，表示原因，用連接詞 because。

fills.en: The new branch office in London ___ by a local company before the staff moved in.
fills.zh: 倫敦的新分公司在員工搬進去之前，由當地一家公司布置好家具。
fills.note: 辦公室是「被」布置的，後面又有 by，用被動式。

fills.en: Please read the ___ carefully before you sign, because it explains the penalty for late delivery.
fills.zh: 簽名前請仔細讀這一條款，因為它說明了延遲交貨的罰則。
fills.note: clause 是合約裡的「條款」。

fills.en: The applicant ___ cover letter impressed the panel will be interviewed on Monday.
fills.zh: 那位求職信讓面試小組印象深刻的應徵者，星期一會來面試。
fills.note: 「應徵者的」求職信，表示所有關係，用 whose。

fills.en: The new heater is ___ efficient than the one we used last year.
fills.zh: 新的暖氣機比我們去年用的那台更有效率。
fills.note: 後面有 than，要用比較級 more。

fills.en: Because factory output was ___, Mr. Ellis decided to add an evening shift.
fills.zh: 因為工廠產量不足，Ellis 先生決定增加一個晚班。
fills.note: 產量「不夠」才需要加班，用 insufficient。

fills.en: The marketing team conducted an ___ survey of 500 office workers.
fills.zh: 行銷團隊對五百名上班族做了一份大規模的調查。
fills.note: 冠詞和名詞 survey 之間要放形容詞 extensive。

fills.en: By the time the inspector arrived, the workers ___ the damaged lamps from the line.
fills.zh: 檢查員抵達時，工人已經把損壞的燈從生產線上拿下來了。
fills.note: By the time + 過去式，表示在那之前已完成，用過去完成式。

fills.en: ___ the training session ran long, every trainee stayed until the end.
fills.zh: 雖然訓練課程拖得很長，每位受訓者都待到了最後。
fills.note: 後面是完整子句，語意是「雖然」，用連接詞 although；despite 和 because of 後面接名詞。

fills.en: Our new branch in London is ___ located near a subway station.
fills.zh: 我們倫敦的新分公司位置很方便，就在地鐵站附近。
fills.note: conveniently located 是「位置便利」。

fills.en: Mr. Lin prepared all the slides ___, so nobody else needed to help.
fills.zh: 林先生自己準備了所有投影片，所以不需要別人幫忙。
fills.note: 「他自己」做的，用反身代名詞 himself。

fills.en: The English class for staff is held every Wednesday ___ 6 p.m. in Room 5A.
fills.zh: 員工英文課每週三晚上六點在 5A 教室上課。
fills.note: 幾點鐘用 at。

fills.en: The committee thanked Mr. Park for his ___ to the company over twenty years.
fills.zh: 委員會感謝朴先生二十年來對公司的付出。
fills.note: 所有格 his 後面要接名詞 dedication。

fills.en: The dental plan is ___, so employees can decide whether to join it.
fills.zh: 牙齒保險是自由參加的，員工可以自己決定要不要加入。
fills.note: 可以自己決定，表示是自願的 voluntary；mandatory 是強制。

fills.en: Mr. Ellis approved the campaign ___ its budget was larger than planned.
fills.zh: 雖然預算比原本計畫的高，Ellis 先生還是核准了這次的活動。
fills.note: 後面是子句，語意是讓步，用 even though；despite 後面接名詞。

fills.en: All new employees are required ___ a safety lesson before they start work.
fills.zh: 所有新進員工開始上班前都必須上安全課程。
fills.note: be required 後面接不定詞 to + 原形動詞。

fills.en: A reporter asked the company ___ to comment on the rumor about layoffs.
fills.zh: 一位記者請公司發言人針對裁員的傳言發表看法。
fills.note: 代表公司對媒體說話的是 spokesperson（發言人）。

fills.en: If the shipment arrives on time, the store ___ the new lamp series on May 1.
fills.zh: 如果貨準時到，店裡會在五月一日推出新的檯燈系列。
fills.note: If + 現在式，主要子句用未來式 will。

fills.en: The new database is ___ easy to use, even for beginners.
fills.zh: 新的資料庫出乎意料地好用，連新手也會用。
fills.note: 修飾形容詞 easy，要用副詞 surprisingly。

fills.en: Profits rose ___ last year, so every employee received a bonus.
fills.zh: 去年獲利大幅成長，所以每位員工都拿到了獎金。
fills.note: rose considerably 是「大幅上升」。

textFills.title: Friday's presentation
lines: Thank you for agreeing to watch my rehearsal on Thursday. My presentation to Mr. Ellis ___ for Friday at 10 a.m.
I am still a little ___ about the charts in the middle section. ___
Please tell me honestly ___ any slide is hard to follow.
zh: Tom 你好：
謝謝你答應星期四來看我預演。我給 Ellis 先生的簡報排在星期五早上十點。
我對中間那段的圖表還是有點擔心。圖表裡的數字很多，所以我可能會在星期五前把它們簡化。
如果有哪張投影片不容易看懂，請老實告訴我。
謝謝，Grace

blanks.note: 簡報是「被安排」的，用被動式。

options: They show a lot of numbers, so I may simplify them before Friday.
Thank you again for your kind remarks after my talk.
Mr. Ellis has worked at the company for over ten years.
Therefore, I have decided not to rehearse this week.
blanks.note: They 指前一句的 charts，接得上。

textFills.title: Notice: Line 2 maintenance
lines: Line 2 will be closed on Saturday ___ regular maintenance.
During the day, our inspectors will examine every machine ___.
Workers from Line 2 ___ to Line 1 for that day only.
Please ask your foreman if you have any questions.
zh: 第二生產線星期六會停工做定期保養。
當天檢查員會仔細檢查每一台機器。
這項檢查通常需要大約六小時。
第二線的員工只有那一天會被調到第一線。
有任何問題請問你的領班。

options: Our new lamp has a natural wood base.
This check usually takes about six hours.
Visitors must stay inside the yellow lines.
The cafeteria will also be closed on Sunday.
blanks.note: This check 指前一句的檢查。
未來的安排，員工被調派，用被動。

textFills.title: Your interview
lines: Thank you for ___ for the junior designer position.
Our panel would like to invite you to an interview on Tuesday, April 2, at 2 p.m. ___
If this time does not work for you, please let me know ___ Friday.
Best regards, Kevin Lee, Human Resources
zh: Cho 小姐您好：
謝謝您應徵初級設計師的職位。
我們的面試小組想邀請您在四月二日星期二下午兩點來面試。面試大約 45 分鐘，包含一個簡短的設計測驗。
如果這個時間您不方便，請在星期五之前告訴我。
期待與您見面。
敬祝順利，人資部 Kevin Lee

blanks.note: 介系詞 for 後面接動名詞。

options: Thank you for coming to the interview yesterday.
It will last about 45 minutes and include a short design test.
Unfortunately, the position has already been filled.
Your first day of work will be Monday, May 6.
blanks.note: It 指前一句的面試，接得上。
在期限之前告知，用 by。
look forward to 後面接動名詞。

textFills.title: Yoga at lunch
lines: Starting next month, the company ___ free yoga classes for all staff.
The classes will be held in Room 3B every Tuesday and Thursday at 12:15 p.m. ___
Space is limited, ___ please sign up early with Human Resources.
Please wear comfortable clothes and bring some water with ___.
zh: 從下個月開始，公司會為全體員工開免費的瑜伽課。
課程每週二和週四中午十二點十五分在 3B 教室上課。每堂課三十分鐘，所以你還有時間吃午餐。
名額有限，請盡早向人資部報名。
請穿舒適的衣服，並自己帶點水。

blanks.note: 下個月才開始，用未來式。

options: Our dental plan covers two checkups a year.
Please return your locker key to the front desk.
Each one lasts thirty minutes, so you will still have time for lunch.
The walking group meets at the front entrance on Fridays.
blanks.note: Each one 指前一句的課程。
名額有限「所以」要早報名。
介系詞 with 後面用受格 you。
